creative_improvements.idea: RSI band SWEET SPOT filter for SHORT entries instead of hard floor
creative_improvements.rationale: 30d data: SHORT RSI 50-60 = 9T 77.8%WR +$0.93 (sweet spot). RSI<35 = 217T 56.2%WR -$1.23. RSI 35-50 = ~200T ~47%WR. The edge is concentrated in RSI 50-60, not in blocking low RSI. Instead of floor=35 (blocks all RSI<35), try: SHORT_RSI_SWEET_MIN=45, SHORT_RSI_SWEET_MAX=60 — boost confidence when RSI is in sweet spot, don't block outside it.
creative_improvements.expected_impact: +$0.30-0.50/7d from higher confidence on high-quality entries
